entries.reason: runs write-journal.py through `uv run`, which needs a `python` on PATH and a uv script environment that a shared cache prune can remove while the suite runs. Five different methods failed this way, on both minors, in five staged receipts and in no checkout receipt (no JSON report, exit 1). The class holds no test that skips.

asserts which interpreter behavior variables the evidence child sees. The staged suite sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE for its children, so the staged full suite on Python 3.13 saw ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] where the checkout run of the same revision saw none. The test reads the staged variable set now.

runs web-to-markdown.py through `uv run --script`; the staged full suite on Python 3.14 failed with uv `cause: No such file or directory` (a uv script environment missing from the cache). Listed by method because the class skips without uv.

probes a config tier in a repo root without search permission. Before the probe confirmed absence by ENOENT or ENOTDIR, Python 3.14's pathlib predicates read the EACCES as an absent .bionic.yml and 3.13's re-raised a bare PermissionError, so the result depended on the minor. Listed by method because the class's tests skip at euid 0.

runs the regenerator with adrs at mode 000, so the lstat of adrs/reviews fails EACCES. Python 3.13's Path.is_symlink raises PermissionError there and Python 3.14's answers False, so the segment walk gave a different reason on each minor until it classified the lstat errno itself. The test asserts the one reason on every minor: 'refusing to read .../adrs/reviews: the reviews directory cannot be examined (PermissionError: EACCES), so its presence cannot be confirmed; it is not read as an absent surface'. Listed by method because the test skips at euid 0.

runs the regenerator with the tree directory at mode 000, so the lstat of adrs fails EACCES. Python 3.13's Path.is_symlink raises PermissionError there and Python 3.14's answers False, so 3.13 printed a bare PermissionError and 3.14 refused naming adrs/reviews. The test asserts the one reason on every minor: 'refusing to read .../adrs: the adrs directory cannot be examined (PermissionError: EACCES), so its presence cannot be confirmed; it is not read as an absent surface'. Listed by method because the test skips at euid 0.

runs the regenerator with adrs/summaries at mode 000. Before the surface and resolver presence were decided by an errno-classified stat, Python 3.13's is_symlink raised PermissionError and Python 3.14's pathlib predicates read the resolver as absent, so the result depended on the minor. Listed by method because the test skips at euid 0.

probes a path locator under a directory at mode 000. Before presence was decided by path_state, Python 3.13's exists() raised PermissionError ('cannot be resolved as a path') and Python 3.14's returned False ('no surface in the tree'), so the refusal text depended on the minor. Listed by method because the test skips at euid 0.

probes a path locator whose one component is 258 bytes through path_state, which replaced a pathlib predicate whose answer under an unsearchable directory differed by minor. The over-long answer itself differs by platform (ENAMETOOLONG on Linux, ENOENT on macOS APFS), and the approved decision lists this test cross-minor so the staged per-minor run exercises the locator probe on each supported Python.

runs the regenerator over a reviews directory at mode 0644. Before each entry was classified by one lstat, Python 3.13's is_symlink raised PermissionError (exit 2) and Python 3.14's predicates answered False, reaching the non-regular-file refusal, so the result depended on the minor. Listed by method because the test skips at euid 0.
